thought.text: ddev refuses to run as root. I'll create a non-root user with docker access.

reasoning_content:
ddev refuses to run as root. I need to create a non-root user and run ddev as that user. Let me create a user and give access to docker.

Also the sha file 404 - not critical.

Let me set up a non-root user, add to docker group (or make docker socket accessible).

action.command: id; getent group docker || groupadd docker; useradd -m -s /bin/bash ddevuser 2>&1 || echo "user exists"; usermod -aG docker ddevuser; ls -la /var/run/docker.sock; chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock; su - ddevuser -c 'docker ps' 2>&1 | head -5; echo "---"; su - ddevuser -c 'ddev --version' 2>&1 | tail -5
